title: [BUG]  Can’t handle JSON/Zod schemas properly at the moment
body:
### Describe the bug

I was testing the Volt's api example that we have at docs, and I am always getting this error:
```ts
{
    "success": false,
    "error": "Failed to generate object"
}
```

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/0618e35a-2fd8-42d4-931e-f422d09fa221)

### Steps To Reproduce

curl for testing:
```bash
curl --location 'http://localhost:3141/agents/reasoning/object' \
--header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
--data '{ "input": "Extract the name and age from: John Doe is 30 years old.", "schema": {"type":"object", "properties": {"name": {"type": "string"}, "age": {"type": "number"}}, "required": ["name", "age"]}, "options": { "userId": "user-123", "conversationId": "your-unique-conversation-id" } }'
```

### Expected behavior

I was expecting to receive a successful response

### Packages

- @ai-sdk/amazon-bedrock: ^2.2.8
- @aws-sdk/credential-providers: ~3.799.0
- @voltagent/core: ~0.1.11
- @voltagent/vercel-ai: ~0.1.5
- zod: ^3.24.3

### Additional Context

_No response_
